title: hotfix-slo-enforcer-connection-leak-hysteresis-fix
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Fix connection pool leak and tune SLO enforcer backoff hysteresis to prevent spurious regional failovers and load-shedding. Adds metrics and tests. Hotfix rollout.
description: Fix an urgent production issue where the SLO enforcer could leak connections and apply overly aggressive backoff/hysteresis, causing unnecessary regional failovers and sustained load-shedding. This PR: 1) fixes a connection return path in rpc/connection_pool to ensure sockets are closed on retry failure, 2) adds a conservative hysteresis window and smoothing for backoff decisions in control/slo_enforcer to avoid oscillation under bursty load, 3) exposes new metrics (slo_enforcer.connection_leaks, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_active) and a tracing span for decision points, 4) adds an e2e integration test that simulates connection resets and verifies no premature failover, 5) includes rollout instructions and a one-line feature flag for instant rollback. Checklist: * [x] fix connection leak * [x] adjust hysteresis and backoff smoothing * [x] add metrics and traces * [x] add tests and CI coverage * [x] rollout plan and rollback flag. Related: ENG-4821, incident INC-2026-02-17. This is a hotfix targeting the live SLO enforcer; request fast review and squash-merge.
commits: fix: ensure connection is returned to pool on RPC failure (rpc/connection_pool.go)
feat(slo_enforcer): add hysteresis window and smoothing (control/slo_enforcer.go)
test(slo): e2e test for connection reset and failover prevention (test/slo_failover_e2e.py)
docs: rollout and rollback notes for hotfix (docs/ops/slo_hotfix.md)
review_comments: Liam Chen: Found a race when pool size is zero; added suggestion to use atomic increment before close. Author: updated pool logic and added unit test.
Priya Patel: Please add metric labels for region and error type. Author: added labels to slo_enforcer.connection_leaks and verified graph names.
Diego Rivera: Can we revert rollout via feature flag? Author: added feature flag SLO_ENFORCER_HYSTERESIS and documented rollback steps.
